markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 话语标记是**说话时的小提示词**，不改意思，但告诉别人你的态度：我要说看法了、我不太确定、我不太同意。用好了，英语**更自然、更有礼貌**。

uses.en: [[In my view]], we should wait a week.
uses.en_zh: 我觉得我们应该再等一周。

uses.en: [[I might be wrong, but]] I think it's a memory leak.
uses.en_zh: 我可能说错了，但我觉得是内存泄漏。

uses.en: [[I see your point, but]] the deadline is tight.
uses.en_zh: 我明白你的意思，不过时间很紧。

opinion.title: 说观点
opinion.rule: 开口先给个信号：**「下面是我的看法」**。I think 最常用；personally 是「我个人」；in my view 正式一点；to be honest 是「说实话」。

examples.en: [[In my view]], the screen needs more white space.
examples.zh: 我觉得这个页面需要多留点白。

examples.en: [[To be honest]], I'm not sure it's worth it.
examples.zh: 说实话，我不确定值不值得。

hedge.title: 留余地
hedge.rule: 不确定，或者怕说得太冲时，加点**软化的词**：seem、might、probably、a bit、I'm not sure。就像说话前先垫个软垫。

examples.en: It [[seems]] that the API is down.
This [[might]] be a problem on older devices.
examples.zh: 这在旧设备上可能会有问题。

examples.en: The new flow is [[a bit]] confusing.
examples.zh: 新流程有点让人搞不清。

examples.en: [[I'm not sure]] this is the best approach.
examples.zh: 我不太确定这是不是最好的办法。

disagree.title: 客气地反驳
disagree.rule: 先**认一下对方**，再说 but。不要一上来就说 You're wrong，听着像在吵架。

examples.en: [[I see what you mean, but]] we don't have time to test it.
examples.zh: 我懂你的意思，但我们没时间测试。

examples.en: [[That's a good point. However,]] users might not notice.
examples.zh: 这点说得好。不过用户可能注意不到。

examples.en: [[I take your point, but]] the data says something different.
examples.zh: 你说的有道理，但数据显示的不一样。

structure.title: 换话题、回正题
structure.rule: 这些词帮你**理顺一段话**：by the way 是顺便说一句，anyway 是回到正题，actually 是「其实」，用来纠正。

examples.en: [[By the way]], did you see the new designs?
examples.zh: 顺便问一下，你看过新设计了吗？

examples.en: [[Anyway]], let's get back to the bug.
examples.zh: 好了，我们说回那个 bug。

examples.en: [[Actually]], the meeting is at three, not two.
examples.zh: 其实会是三点，不是两点。

this.en: [[I might be wrong, but]] this could break the login.

that.en: I'm [[currently]] working on the payment page.

commonMistakes.bad: ~~In my opinion, I think~~ it's fine.
commonMistakes.why: 两个都是「我觉得」，说一个就够了。

commonMistakes.bad: ~~According to me~~, it's a good idea.
commonMistakes.good: [[In my view]], it's a good idea.
commonMistakes.why: according to 后面跟别人或资料，不跟 me。

commonMistakes.bad: ~~Actually~~ I'm working on the payment page.
commonMistakes.good: I'm [[currently]] working on the payment page.
commonMistakes.why: 想说「目前」用 currently；actually 是「其实」。

commonMistakes.bad: ~~You're wrong.~~ The deadline is too tight.
commonMistakes.good: [[I see your point, but]] the deadline is too tight.
commonMistakes.why: 先认一下对方，再说不同意。

quiz.prompt: 改错：In my opinion, I think it's fine.
accept: I think it's fine.
In my opinion it's fine.
quiz.explain: 意思重复，留一个就行：[[In my opinion]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：According to me, it's a good idea.
quiz.answer: In my view, it's a good idea.
accept: In my opinion, it's a good idea.
I think it's a good idea.
Personally, I think it's a good idea.
In my view it's a good idea.
quiz.explain: 说自己的看法用 [[In my view]] 或 In my opinion。

quiz.prompt: To be ___, I'm not sure it's worth it.

options: This might not be quite right.
quiz.answer: This might not be quite right.
quiz.explain: [[might]] 和 quite 让话软了很多。

quiz.prompt: It ___ that the API is down. Can someone check?
accept: appears

quiz.prompt: 加上 a bit 说得软一点：The new flow is confusing.
quiz.answer: The new flow is a bit confusing.
accept: The new flow's a bit confusing.
quiz.explain: 加 [[a bit]] 放在形容词前。

quiz.prompt: 同事想把发布提前一周，你不太同意。最客气的说法是：
options: I see what you mean, but we don't have time to test.
quiz.answer: I see what you mean, but we don't have time to test.
quiz.explain: 先认一下对方：[[I see what you mean, but]]…

quiz.prompt: I take your ___, but the data says something different.
quiz.explain: 固定说法：[[I take your point, but]]…

quiz.prompt: 改错（说得客气点）：You're wrong, the deadline is too tight.
quiz.answer: I see your point, but the deadline is too tight.
accept: I see what you mean, but the deadline is too tight.
I take your point, but the deadline is too tight.
I see your point, but I think the deadline is too tight.
I'm not sure I agree. The deadline is too tight.
quiz.explain: 先认一下对方再说 but：[[I see your point, but]]…

quiz.prompt: ___ the way, did you see the new designs?
accept: by

quiz.prompt: OK, that's enough about lunch. ___, let's get back to the bug.
— The meeting's at two, right? — ___, it's at three.
改错：Actually I'm working on the payment page.（想说：我目前在做支付页面）
quiz.answer: I'm currently working on the payment page.
accept: Currently, I'm working on the payment page.
Currently I'm working on the payment page.
I'm working on the payment page at the moment.
At the moment, I'm working on the payment page.

quiz.prompt: 翻译：我可能说错了，但我觉得这是内存泄漏。
quiz.answer: I might be wrong, but I think it's a memory leak.
accept: I may be wrong, but I think it's a memory leak.
I could be wrong, but I think it's a memory leak.
I might be wrong, but I think this is a memory leak.
I may be wrong, but I think this is a memory leak.
I could be wrong, but I think this is a memory leak.
quiz.explain: 留余地：[[I might be wrong, but]]…

openTask.prompt: 假设在评审会上，同事提了一个你不太同意的方案。用 3 句话回应：先说观点，再留点余地，最后客气地提出不同意见。
rules: 至少用一个说观点的标记（personally / in my view / to be honest）
反驳前先认一下对方（I see your point, but…）
openTask.note: 规则判有没有用到对应的话语标记（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
